method: Batch 41. Same double, row layout and script ops as fireballs-reference.json, plus: `ground k x y z` sets EntityFireball.inGround, xTile, yTile, zTile and inTile of ball k to the block at (x, y, z) (no 1.7.10 path sets them; EntityFireball.onUpdate then runs natively: ticksAlive counts to 600, a missing or different tile releases the ball with its motion scaled by three Random floats); `air x y z` removes a block; `hurt` kinds a<i> (an arrow shot by mob i) and t<i> (a thrown snowball of mob i). With `tickMobs` every mob is updated each tick before the fireballs (types x skeleton, w snow golem added) and a fireball a mob spawns joins the list at once and ticks in the same pass; `shots` lists them as [tick, large, shooter index, Entity.rand seed].
